objective: Execute the source-backed heavy scientific-validation path on a dedicated ci/heavy branch and capture real external acquisition evidence.

baseline.description: Heavy validation trigger exists on ci/heavy branches; real source-backed execution must produce evidence without bypassing scientific gates.

source_backed_execution.reason: This commit is intended to trigger the heavy workflow; final status must come from GitHub Actions evidence.

evidence: Heavy job is configured to run on push events for ci/heavy/** branches.
validation.blocker: Workflow execution and emitted acquisition/derivation evidence must be inspected before acceptance.

root_causes: Heavy validation previously lacked an autonomous push-triggered execution path on a dedicated branch.

findings: A dedicated ci/heavy branch provides a reproducible trigger for expensive source-backed validation without changing main runtime behavior.

open_blockers: External source acquisition and deterministic 730k derivation must either produce valid evidence or fail closed with a concrete external blocker.
